- Distance (in the Notes column) must be at least 60 meters (i.e., ≥ 60.00 m).

4. 2004 Olympic Games – 62.58 m → ≥ 60 → include.  
5. 2006 Commonwealth Games – 60.99 m → ≥ 60 → include.  
6. 2007 All-Africa Games – 57.79 m → less than 60 → exclude.  
7. 2008 African Championships – 56.98 m → less than 60 → exclude.  

Count included events: 2003 All-Africa Games, 2004 African Championships, 2004 Olympic Games, 2006 Commonwealth Games → that's 4 events.
